title: Sternberg working memory: human microwire LFP from medial temporal and medial frontal lobe (Daume et al. 2024, DANDI 000673)
description: Microwire local field potential (LFP) recordings from Behnke-Fried hybrid depth electrodes in 35 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy undergoing invasive seizure monitoring. Patients performed a Sternberg working-memory task with pictures (load 1 or 3). Recording sites include the hippocampus, amygdala, dorsal anterior cingulate cortex, pre-supplementary motor area and ventromedial prefrontal cortex. This is an iEEG-BIDS representation of the NWB data released on DANDI (000673), with signal values unchanged apart from float32 conversion.
methods_description: Broadband signals were recorded at 32 kHz (Neuralynx) or 30 kHz (Blackrock) from microwire bundles. The authors removed spike waveforms by interpolation, applied a 175 Hz zero-phase low-pass filter and downsampled to 400 Hz. The LFP series were converted to BrainVision float32 microvolts without further filtering, resampling, re-referencing or channel removal. Trials, TTL markers and picture presentations were mapped to events files.
